tool.name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
tool.description: Entra identity platform for AI agents: agent identities and blueprints with Conditional Access, ID Protection and governance.
tool.pricing: Agent ID is available to all Microsoft Entra customers; Conditional Access, ID Protection and governance for agents require a Microsoft Agent 365 license (included in Microsoft 365 E7).
tool.practitionerNote: Default choice for Microsoft-centric tenants; budget for Agent 365 licensing, because the base Agent ID platform does not include agent Conditional Access or access packages.

dataResidency.detail: Agent ID docs reviewed do not state agent-specific data residency controls; follows the Entra tenant's home geography (not confirmed for Agent ID).

deployment.detail: Microsoft-managed SaaS within Microsoft Entra; third-party agents integrate via the Auth SDK sidecar or workload identity federation.

auditLogging.detail: All agent authentication and activity is logged in Entra sign-in and audit logs.

soc2.detail: Microsoft Entra ID is listed in Microsoft's Office 365 SOC 2 Type 2 scope for GCC/GCC High/DoD; Agent ID is not listed separately.

iso27001.detail: Azure ISO 27001 page lists service families (Azure, Microsoft 365) without naming Entra Agent ID; scope detail sits in the Service Trust Portal.

iso42001.detail: Not among the Microsoft AI services listed in scope for ISO/IEC 42001 (list covers Copilot, Copilot Studio, Foundry and others).

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Microsoft SaaS tied to Entra and Agent 365 licensing.
